title: Violent Albania Protests Escalate: Student movement confronts Edi Rama; hundreds detained, dozens injured
summary_full: In Tirana, a large assembly of students is rallying for Prime Minister Edi Rama's resignation, citing rampant corruption. Tensions escalated into violent confrontations with riot police, resulting in several injuries. The protests highlight widespread dissatisfaction in Albania linked to job scarcity and corruption, aligning with similar movements across Europe regarding public services and living expenses.
